body: I think my suggested code is clearer. It checks for two cases where the identifier name shouldn't be fully qualified.
That seems to work, although the test cases fail due to being generated with slightly different trivia, so I'll need to update that.

```suggestion
                bool isInitializer = isFirstNode && node.Parent is AssignmentExpressionSyntax { Parent: InitializerExpressionSyntax };
```

This can be merged into a single pattern, since we don't use `aes` for anything else later.
